Questions on moving from B1 to A5

We are married and had our first meeting at MH TLV on July 27 where I received my B1 visa. They also gave us our appointment for the end of February to move to the A5. They gave us a paper instructing us to submit our updated documents one month prior to our next appointment. My understanding was these should be submitted 3 months prior. Is this a discrepancy or possibly correct since we had our first meeting more recently? 

Should we expect to have an interview at this appointment for moving to the A5 or will it be more similar to our initial appointment which was pretty quick and they mostly spoke to my husband who is Israeli? 

Thank you in advance!
